notes:
つまらない is an i-adjective with two main meanings: boring/dull and trivial/worthless.

FORMS:
- Adverb: つまらなく
- Past: つまらなかった

MEANINGS:
1. Boring/dull: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つまらない (This movie is boring)
2. Trivial/worthless: つまらない⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ (get angry over trivial things)

CULTURAL EXPRESSION:
「つまらない⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧」(It's nothing special, but...) is a humble phrase used when giving gifts. It doesn't literally mean the gift is boring.

CONTRAST:
- ⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧: interesting, fun (antonym)
- ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧な: boring (na-adjective, more formal)
